title: Minimum Path Sum
goal: Solve Minimum Path Sum: Store the cheapest right/down path to each cell using its value plus the cheaper reachable predecessor.
strategy: Store the cheapest right/down path to each cell using its value plus the cheaper reachable predecessor.
edgeCases: The first row and column have only one predecessor; their costs must accumulate rather than reset.
inputRules: Grid must be 2D array of numbers
All values must be non-negative numbers
